calls.result_text:
SQL:
WITH _cm_tags__value_count_distinct_partition_by_id AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.tags.id" AS "tags__id",
    _stage_inner."__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value_count_distinct_partition_by_tags_id" AS "value_count_distinct_partition_by_tags_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tags.id AS "__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.tags.id",
      COUNT(DISTINCT __slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value) AS "__slayer_list__9_customers__tags.value_count_distinct_partition_by_tags_id"
    FROM customers AS tags
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        __slayer_u.value
      FROM UNNEST(tags.tags) AS __slayer_u(value)
      WHERE
        __slayer_u.value IS NOT NULL
    ) AS __slayer_list__9_customers__tags
    GROUP BY
      tags.id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        _cm_tags__value_count_distinct_partition_by_id."value_count_distinct_partition_by_tags_id",
        0
      )
    END AS "customers.n_tags"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN _cm_tags__value_count_distinct_partition_by_id
    ON customers.id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_tags__value_count_distinct_partition_by_id."tags__id"
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        _cm_tags__value_count_distinct_partition_by_id."value_count_distinct_partition_by_tags_id",
        0
      )
    END
), _cm_customers___count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "customers._count"
  FROM customers AS customers
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.n_tags",
  COALESCE(_cm_customers___count."customers._count", 0) AS "customers.customers"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_customers___count
ORDER BY
  _base."customers.n_tags" ASC
LIMIT 21
